entries.title: Technical Deep Dive Discovery
entries.description: Lead with technical credibility by understanding their current stack, pain points, and developer workflows before pitching solutions.
entries.whenToUse: Enterprise deals with technical buyers, DevOps-heavy organizations, platform engineering teams
steps: Research their tech stack via job postings, GitHub, and blog posts
Prepare 3-5 specific questions about their development workflow
Ask about their biggest developer productivity challenges
Understand their current code search and navigation tools
Map their responses to specific product capabilities
talkingPoints: What's your current approach to finding code across repositories?
How do new developers get up to speed on your codebase?
When a security vulnerability is found, how do you track affected code?
successIndicators: Prospect shares specific pain points unprompted
Technical stakeholders lean forward and engage
Prospect asks 'how would you handle X?'
Meeting runs over scheduled time due to engagement

entries.title: Live Code Search Demo
entries.description: Demo using the prospect's actual public repositories to show immediate value and relevance.
entries.whenToUse: Technical validation calls, POC kickoffs, when prospect has public OSS presence
steps: Before the call, add their public repos to a demo instance
Prepare 2-3 searches relevant to their domain/stack
Start by searching for a common pattern in their code
Show cross-repo navigation with their actual code
Let them drive the demo with their own searches
talkingPoints: Let me show you this in your actual codebase...
Here's how you'd find all uses of this pattern across your repos
What would you want to search for right now?
successIndicators: Prospect says 'wow' or 'that's exactly what I need'
Request to add more repos or private repos

entries.title: Champion Enablement Package
entries.description: Equip your champion with materials to sell internally, including ROI calculators, executive summaries, and objection handlers.
entries.whenToUse: After identifying a strong champion, before they need to present to leadership
steps: Create customized executive summary with their specific metrics
Build ROI calculator with their developer count and hourly rates
Prepare objection handling guide for common internal pushback
Offer to do a dry-run of their internal presentation
Provide competitive comparison if needed
talkingPoints: I want to make sure you have everything you need to present this internally
What objections do you anticipate from [stakeholder]?
Would it help if I prepared a one-pager for your leadership?
successIndicators: Champion shares draft of their internal presentation
Champion introduces you to other stakeholders

entries.title: Security Concern Handler
entries.description: Address enterprise security concerns by leading with compliance certifications and deployment options.
entries.whenToUse: When security team is involved, regulated industries, when 'security review' is mentioned
steps: Acknowledge security as a priority
Lead with SOC 2 Type II certification
Explain self-hosted deployment option
Offer to schedule security deep-dive call
Provide security whitepaper and questionnaire responses
talkingPoints: Security is a top priority for us as well - we're SOC 2 Type II certified
Many of our enterprise customers run Sourcegraph self-hosted for complete control
We have pre-filled responses for common security questionnaires
successIndicators: Security team approves without extended review
Security concern no longer blocks deal progress
